name: sol-luna-orchestrator
description: MCP server that lets a supervising OpenAI Codex agent delegate bounded executable tasks singly, sequentially, or in parallel, with per-task file scopes, scope-violation detection, and independently verified results.
author: Mahad Ansar <mahadansar00@gmail.com> (https://github.com/mahadansar)
